title: Global ignition is a positive feedback loop in the field

statements.text: Below a threshold the fields of a few synchronous neurons are too weak to move others. Past it, the field recruits more neurons into re-entrant synchronous circuits, a positive feedback loop that produces the all-or-nothing global ignition described as a signature of consciousness.

sources.quote: This EM field loop will rapidly amplify and expand the network of synchronous oscillations to create the kind of global ignition or neuronal avalanche
